_comment: Mainnet account snapshots for Raydium AMM V4 and Serum DEX trading pair SOL/USDC

raydium_pool.json.description: Core state for Raydium V4 SOL/USDC pool containing status flags, fees (25 bps), and vault references.

coin_vault.json.description: Raydium base token vault holding WSOL reserves (offsets 64..72 read by LiteSVM).

pc_vault.json.description: Raydium quote token vault holding USDC reserves used for constant-product pricing.

open_orders.json.description: On-chain account tracking open orders placed by Raydium on the Serum DEX orderbook.

target_orders.json.description: Rebalancing target orders account required in Raydium 18-account swap instruction vector.

market.json.description: Serum SOL/USDC market configuration defining lot sizes, orderbook pointers, and vault signer seeds.

bids.json.description: Memory slab tree containing active buy orders on the Serum orderbook.

asks.json.description: Memory slab tree containing active sell orders on the Serum orderbook.

event_q.json.description: Serum trade execution and event settlement queue account.

market_coin_vault.json.description: Serum internal base vault holding WSOL committed to the orderbook.

market_pc_vault.json.description: Serum internal quote vault holding USDC committed to the orderbook.
